text_zh:
D-Wave发布最新门模型路线图，目标是2032年实现100个逻辑量子比特系统
6月1日，
D-Wave发布了一套门模型量子计算路线图，目标是到2032年实现100多逻辑量子比特容错系统，能够执行超过一百万次运算，潜力在量子化学和量子人工智能领域。该路线图聚焦于D-Wave的超导双轨量子比特架构，该架构设计用于检测计算过程中约90%的量子比特错误，并减少量子纠错所需的物理量子比特开销。计划中的里程碑包括2026年拥有17个物理量子比特的系统，2027年拥有49个物理量子比特，2028年达到181个物理量子比特，2030年实现10个逻辑量子比特容错系统，以及到2032年实现100个逻辑量子比特的系统。
来源：
https://www.dwavequantum.com/company/newsroom/press-release/d-wave-charts-a-new-course-to-fault-tolerant-quantum-computing-with-gate-model-roadmap/
Microsoft发布Majorana 2，量子比特寿命平均20秒，性能提升1000倍
6月2日，
Microsoft发布Majorana 2处理器，量子比特寿命平均20秒，比早期设备长1000倍以上，支持其到2029年构建可扩展量子计算机的目标。公司通过在超导材料堆栈中用铅替代铝材并重新设计半导体结构，提升了性能，使保护量子比特免受错误的拓扑间隙翻倍多。这些结果是在Microsoft拓扑量子计算方法持续受到审视的背景下发布的，被呈现为更大的拓扑间隙能够显著提升量子比特稳定性并支持未来容错量子系统的证据。
来源：
https://quantum.microsoft.com/en-us/insights/blogs/majorana-2-scalable-quantum-processor
加拿大航天局提发布
500
万美元资助项目，用于与英国建设卫星量子通信链路
6月3日，加拿大航天局（CSA）发布了一项500万美元的资金机会，用于开发一个安全的跨大西洋量子通信网络。有意企业必须在2026年7月15日前提交申请。该项目直接源自加拿大和英国总理于2025年6月签署的联合承诺，共同目标是利用量子密钥分发技术构建下一代通信网络。CSA设定了严格的标准，只有在加拿大成立并运营的营利性组织才有资格。项目预计从2026年9月开始运行24至36个月。
来源：
https://www.asc-csa.gc.ca/eng/funding-programs/funding-opportunities/ao/2026-secure-transatlantic-quantum-communications-demonstration.asp
华翊量子完成
A+
轮融资，资金将用于新一代量子计算机研发
6月1日消息，近日，国内离子阱量子计算领军企业“华翊量子”完成A+轮融资，由建投投资领投，中信建投等机构跟投，百度风投等老股东追加。本轮融资距上轮不足半年，资金将重点投向新一代量子计算机研发、量算与AI融合及商业化落地。该公司由段路明院士创立，其自主研发的100+比特离子阱量子计算机商业化原型机已正式交付中国移动研究院。

QUDORA与日本Fixstars Amplify达成合作，量子计算机将上线云平台

德国离子阱量子计算公司
QUDORA宣布与日本Fixstars Amplify达成合作，将其量子软件栈集成至后者的云环境中。用户将能通过现有的云工作流访问QUDORA的量子计算机。合作首阶段将上线其先进的量子仿真器Qamelion，随后将直接开放离子阱量子计算硬件系统的访问权限。此举在无需专属基础设施的情况下，为企业及研究机构提供了直接获取量子硬件的渠道，并将进一步扩大QUDORA在日本市场的业务版图。

Quantum AI for Science新范式

近日，北京量坤科技有限公司累计完成数亿元人民币的天使轮及天使
+轮两轮融资。本轮系列融资由英诺天使基金领投，国汽投资、北工投资、BV百度风投、水木清华校友基金、明势创投、北京科创基金、基石创投、东方嘉富、启迪裕麟、力合金融等多家机构参与投资。本轮融资将主要用于核心技术研发、产品平台建设、产业场景拓展和高水平人才引进。

6月1日，
据路透社报道，
Quantinuum已扩大了IPO的规模和定价，使其潜在估值提升至约143亿美元。公司计划以每股53至55美元的价格发行2650万股，预计在纳斯达克上市前筹集多达14.6亿美元，股票代码为“QNT”。更高的估值反映了投资者对量子计算兴趣的增长，并紧随商务部暂定的1亿美元资金协议，以支持Quantinuum的离子阱量子系统开发。

、
HBKU
和卡塔尔国防部联合，启动卡塔尔首个量子安全网络

Ooredoo卡塔尔公司联合哈马德·本·哈利法大学（HBKU）及卡塔尔国防部，
利用量子密钥分发技术部署了卡塔尔首个量子安全通信链路。该系统集成进了
Ooredoo的运营网络，成功生成并分发了跨多条光纤链路距离的加密密钥。该项目旨在加强卡塔尔的网络安全能力，支持量子安全数字基础设施的发展。

与
Creative Biostructure
合作，部署量子赋能的
EPR
光谱
6月2日，
High Q Technologies与Creative Biostructure建立了合作伙伴关系，支持EPR光谱在制药和生物技术研究中的更广泛应用。此次合作结合了High Q Technologies的FATHOM量子EPR光谱平台与Creative Biostructure在实验设计、科学咨询和工作流程支持方面的专业知识。这些公司旨在帮助研究人员研究蛋白质动力学、分子运动以及药物发现中涉及的复杂生物系统。

IQM与Real Asset Acquisition Corp.联合宣布，由于获得来自Ilmarinen的新增投资承诺，其私募股权投资（PIPE）融资规模已成功扩大至1.46亿美元。此举彰显了资本市场对量子计算前沿技术及IQM行业领先地位的强劲信心，将加速推进量子技术的商业化应用与技术迭代。

芬兰启动
QScale项目，推进量子计算可扩展性
6月2日，
芬兰国家技术研究中心（
VTT）联合坦佩雷大学和阿尔托大学启动了QScale项目，并获得Business Finland资助。该项目旨在通过研发先进的光学控制和超精准信号技术，从根本上提升量子计算机的能量效率与可扩展性，为量子应用的规模化发展奠定技术基础。

Quantinuum与三菱电机达成战略合作，探索量子计算工业工程应用
6月2日，
Quantinuum与三菱电机签署谅解备忘录，建立战略合作伙伴关系。双方将依托Quantinuum的高保真离子阱量子系统与算法服务，结合三菱电机的制造与数字化经验，重点围绕计算机辅助工程（CAE）等领域，共同开发用于先进工业工程和设计的下一代量子及混合方法，以提前布局并塑造未来的商业化应用场景。

QuiX Quantum宣布安装通用光子量子计算机的实时控制组件
6月2日，
硬件开发商
QuiX Quantum宣布其前馈控制单元（FFCU）的初始安装。这是为公司通用光子量子计算架构开发的高性能硬件组件。该高性能模块直接集成到公司的通用光子量子计算栈中，设计用于处理实时自适应操作。通过在硬件层面自动化状态重构，控制机制建立了基于测量的量子计算架构所需的快速反馈回路。
来源：
https://www.einpresswire.com/article/916649241/quix-quantum-installs-real-time-control-component-for-universal-photonic-quantum-computer
Atom Computing
宣布实现业内首次基于托里克码
量子纠错完整演示
6月3日，
美国量子计算公司
Atom Computing宣布，成功实现了行业内首次基于托里克码（toric code）的量子纠错完整演示。测试表明，随着计算中使用的量子比特数量增加，其中性原子系统的错误率随之降低。这一成果使该公司成为全球仅有的两家能实现多轮持续量子纠错的公司之一，也是中性原子技术领域的首例，标志着容错量子计算迈出关键一步。
来源：
https://atom-computing.com/atom-computing-reveals-quantum-error-correction-with-toric-code/
英飞凌将
OPTIGA TPM
与
NVIDIA Jetson Thor
集成，提供量子防御支持
6月3日，
英飞凌将其
OPTIGA TPM SLB 9672安全芯片与英伟达的Jetson Thor平台集成，为机器人和物理人工智能系统提供基于硬件、量子韧性的信任根。TPM支持安全密钥存储、测量启动、远程认证、加密通信以及自主系统生命周期内的受保护软件更新。英飞凌表示，其TPM路线图包括支持NIST标准化的后量子密码算法，帮助未来机器人部署应对不断变化的安全和合规要求。

https://www.infineon.com/press-release/2026/infxx202606-104
Qunova
加入日本国家级高性能计算计划，提供先进工业计算算法
6月3日，
量子计算软件开发商
Qunova Computing宣布与日本高性能计算（JHPC-quantum）签署合作备忘录，正式加入其测试用户计划。作为仅有的两家非日本入选机构之一，Qunova将获准免费使用结合“富岳”超级计算机和IBM量子系统二号的混合平台，并运用其专有的HI-VQE算法，攻关材料科学与药物研发中的量子化学难题，加速工业量子优势的商业化部署。

https://qunovacomputing.com/news/140
Anyon
与
Q-CTRL
达成合作，推出模块化自校准混合量子超级计算机
6月3日，
Anyon Technologies与Q-CTRL宣布达成战略合作，通过将前者的混合系统与后者的基础设施软件相结合，成功为企业数据中心打造出模块化、可自校准的混合量子超级计算机。该成果首次实现了数据中心规模下量子超级计算机的持续、高性能运行，标志着量子计算正加速迈向大规模商业化应用阶段。

完成
2.6
亿英镑
C
轮融资，加速容错量子计算研发
6月3日，
英国量子计算公司
OQC宣布完成超额认购的2.6亿英镑（约3.5亿美元）C轮融资，创下欧洲量子计算领域最大规模的私募融资纪录。本轮融资由Bullhound Capital领投，众多新老投资方及国家级基金跟投，J.P. Morgan担任独家配售代理。作为全球超导量子计算领军企业，OQC业务已覆盖欧美及亚洲，本轮资金将用于加速容错量子计算的技术研发，并扩大其在全球关键数据中心市场的国际化基础设施布局。

15
亿元量子产业基金
6月3日，
中国电信控股子公司科大国盾量子技术股份有限公司拟与关联方中电信量子（北京）企业管理合伙企业（有限合伙）、中国电信集团投资有限公司及其他各方共同出资设立
“中电信量子产业创业投资基金（有限合伙）”。据介绍，上述投资各方合计认缴出资额为15亿元。其中，国盾量子拟以自有资金出资3亿元，占量子基金份额的比例为20%。中电信私募基金管理有限公司担任量子基金的管理人，是中电信量子企业管理的执行事务合伙人和电信投资的全资子公司。

获得
1.15
亿欧元
A
轮融资，用于工业化硅自旋量子比特处理器
6月3日，
Quobly宣布完成价值1.15亿欧元（约1.335亿美元）的A轮融资，旨在将其基于硅的量子计算架构从技术验证转向主动工业执行。此次资本扩建由Bpifrance、后量子网络安全专家SEALSQ以及半导体制造商意法半导体共同领导。欧洲创新理事会（EIC基金）、Blast、ALIAD以及早期投资者Innovacom提供了额外的机构和战略支持。这笔融资将支持持续的研发、工业化努力和国际商业扩展，标志着Quobly迈向工业规模量子计算路线图的关键一步。

OQC
、摩根大通和
AMD
合作，探索混合量子
-
经典计算应用

硬件开发商牛津量子电路（
OQC）、金融服务提供商摩根大通以及半导体设计商AMD共同启动了一项专注于量子系统与经典高性能计算（HPC）节点集成的研究合作项目。该项目利用了由OQC在伦敦新建的专用量子人工智能数据中心。该基础设施设计为安全的企业级测试平台，使企业和学术研究团队能够根据全球金融行业要求的数据复制、延迟和安全标准评估经典-量子混合软件配置。

https://www.amd.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-6-3-oqc-jpmorganchase-and-amd-commence-research-collaborata.html
KQC
采用
LS ITC
，完成基于
PQC
的安全概念验证
6月4日，
据
Digital Today报道，KQC表示，已与LS集团IT服务公司LS ITC完成了一项概念验证，旨在验证基于量子密码学的后量子加密安全技术，以防范使用代理人工智能的黑客攻击及量子计算机带来的风险。该项目测试了基于PQC的FIDO认证密钥、服务器间认证和连接控制，采用中央秘密管理，以及SSL/TLS证书的自动签发和续期。此次技术验证（PoC）成功展示了基于PQC的安全技术在工业环境中的实际适用性。

Quantinuum
在纳斯达克首次亮相，首次公开募资
16.8
亿美元
6月4日，
Quantinuum在首次公开募股（IPO）募资16.8亿美元后开始在纳斯达克交易，这意味着估值约在140亿至150亿美元之间，成为迄今为止量子计算领域最重要的公开市场首次亮相之一。该交易结构以每股60.00美元的公开发行价发行了28000000股A类普通股，将初始资本目标扩大至约16.8亿美元的总收益。根据最终定价指标，该里程碑为该离子阱硬件开发商奠定了156亿美元的初始市场估值，并将其指定为量子计算产业领域公开股权估值的参考基准。

https://www.quantinuum.com/press-releases/quantinuum-announces-pricing-of-upsized-initial-public-offering
QuantX Labs
获得
500
万美元种子轮融资，由
Serendipity Capital
主导
6月4日，
Serendipity Capital领导了一项价值500万美元（700万澳元）的种子投资，投资于澳大利亚的光学原子钟开发商QuantX Labs，专注于国防、航天及关键基础设施应用。QuantX Labs表示，其光学原子钟比现有系统稳定10到100倍，同时体积更小、便携性和坚固耐用。公司已通过澳大利亚国防部合同和最近的SpaceX任务部署了其技术，Serendipity Capital的合作伙伴兼联合创始人Anton Jerga将加入董事会。

C12
引入碳纳米管量子芯片纳米组装工艺
Pick&Place
6月4日，
C12发布了其专有的“选置”纳米组装工艺Pick&Place，旨在高精度地将单个碳纳米管转移到硅芯片上，用于量子处理器制造。公司表示，该工艺能够在集成前对碳纳米管进行预选和鉴定，有助于解决量子比特变异问题并改善制造控制。C12报告称，新方法显著提高了生产吞吐量，并支持高密度多量子比特芯片架构的集成。

、
NKT

# Weekly Report | D-Wave Releases Latest Gate-Model Roadmap, Targeting 100 Logical Qubit System by 2032; Microsoft Releases Majorana 2 with 1,000× Performance Improvement……

## D-Wave Releases Latest Gate-Model Quantum Computing Roadmap, Targeting a 100+ Logical Qubit Fault-Tolerant System by 2032

On June 1, D-Wave released a gate-model quantum computing roadmap targeting a fault-tolerant system with more than 100 logical qubits by 2032, capable of executing over one million operations, with potential applications in quantum chemistry and quantum artificial intelligence. The roadmap focuses on D-Wave's superconducting dual-rail qubit architecture, which is designed to detect approximately 90% of qubit errors during computation and to reduce the physical qubit overhead required for quantum error correction. Planned milestones include a 17-physical-qubit system in 2026, a 49-physical-qubit system in 2027, 181 physical qubits in 2028, a 10-logical-qubit fault-tolerant system in 2030, and a 100-logical-qubit system by 2032.

**Source:** https://www.dwavequantum.com/company/newsroom/press-release/d-wave-charts-a-new-course-to-fault-tolerant-quantum-computing-with-gate-model-roadmap/

## Microsoft Releases Majorana 2 with Average Qubit Lifetime of 20 Seconds — 1,000× Performance Improvement

On June 2, Microsoft released the Majorana 2 processor, featuring an average qubit lifetime of 20 seconds — more than 1,000 times longer than early devices — in support of the company's goal to build a scalable quantum computer by 2029. Microsoft improved performance by replacing aluminum with lead in its superconducting material stack and redesigning the semiconductor structure, more than doubling the topological gap that protects qubits from errors. These results were published amid continued scrutiny of Microsoft's topological quantum computing approach, and are presented as evidence that a larger topological gap can significantly enhance qubit stability and support future fault-tolerant quantum systems.

**Source:** https://quantum.microsoft.com/en-us/insights/blogs/majorana-2-scalable-quantum-processor

## Canadian Space Agency Launches CAD $5 Million Funding Opportunity for Satellite Quantum Communication Link with the United Kingdom

On June 3, the Canadian Space Agency (CSA) announced a $5 million funding opportunity to develop a secure transatlantic quantum communication network. Interested organizations must submit applications by July 15, 2026. The initiative stems directly from a joint commitment signed by the Prime Ministers of Canada and the United Kingdom in June 2025, with a shared goal of building next-generation communication networks using quantum key distribution (QKD) technology. The CSA has established strict eligibility criteria, limiting applications to for-profit organizations incorporated and operating in Canada. The project is expected to run for 24 to 36 months beginning in September 2026.

**Source:** https://www.asc-csa.gc.ca/eng/funding-programs/funding-opportunities/ao/2026-secure-transatlantic-quantum-communications-demonstration.asp

## Huayi Quantum (华翊量子) Closes Series A+ Financing Round; Funds to Support Next-Generation Quantum Computer Development

On June 1, Huayi Quantum (华翊量子), a leading domestic ion trap quantum computing company, completed a Series A+ financing round led by Jiantou Investment (建投投资), with participation from CITIC Construction Investment (中信建投) and additional investment from existing shareholder Baidu Ventures (百度风投), among others. This round closed less than six months after the previous round. Proceeds will be focused on next-generation quantum computer R&D, the integration of quantum computing with AI, and commercial deployment. The company was founded by Academician Duan Luming (段路明院士); its independently developed 100+ qubit ion trap quantum computer commercial prototype has been formally delivered to China Mobile Research Institute.

**Source:** https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/1WA2gDRlLoiQJPYUOIiq4w

## Germany's QUDORA and Japan's Fixstars Amplify Announce Partnership to Bring Quantum Computer onto Cloud Platform

On June 1, German ion trap quantum computing company QUDORA announced a partnership with Japan's Fixstars Amplify to integrate its quantum software stack into the latter's cloud environment. Users will be able to access QUDORA's quantum computers through existing cloud workflows. The first phase of the collaboration will make its advanced quantum simulator Qamelion available online, followed by direct access to the ion trap quantum computing hardware system. This initiative provides enterprises and research institutions with direct access to quantum hardware without requiring dedicated infrastructure, and will further expand QUDORA's business presence in the Japanese market.

**Source:** https://qudef.com/2026/06/01/press-release-qudef-launches-sqout-the-first-quantum-threat-intelligence-platform-for-qkd-and-quantum-communication-systems/

(北京量坤科技有限公司) announced the cumulative completion of two rounds of angel financing — Angel Round and Angel+ Round — totaling hundreds of millions of RMB. The series was led by Inno Angel Fund (英诺天使基金), with participation from Guoqi Investment (国汽投资), Beijing Industrial Investment (北工投资), BV Baidu Ventures (BV百度风投), Tsinghua Alumni Fund (水木清华校友基金), Mingshi Ventures (明势创投), Beijing Science and Technology Innovation Fund (北京科创基金), Cornerstone Ventures (基石创投), Orient Jiafu (东方嘉富), Qidi Yulin (启迪裕麟), and Lihe Finance (力合金融). The proceeds will be primarily used for core technology R&D, product platform development, expansion into industry application scenarios, and the recruitment of high-caliber talent.

**Source:** https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/RIizerhWZCLE4kXGxK_ZTg

On June 1, Reuters reported that Quantinuum has upsized the scale and pricing of its IPO, raising its potential valuation to approximately $14.3 billion. The company plans to offer 26.5 million shares at $53–$55 per share, aiming to raise up to $1.46 billion prior to listing on Nasdaq under the ticker "QNT." The higher valuation reflects growing investor interest in quantum computing and follows a preliminary $100 million funding agreement with the Department of Commerce to support Quantinuum's ion trap quantum system development.

On June 1, Ooredoo Qatar, Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU), and Qatar's Ministry of Defence jointly deployed Qatar's first quantum-safe communication link using quantum key distribution technology. The system has been integrated into Ooredoo's operational network, successfully generating and distributing encryption keys across multiple fiber link distances. The project aims to strengthen Qatar's cybersecurity capabilities and support the development of quantum-safe digital infrastructure.

**Source:** https://www.qatar-tribune.com/article/236916/latest-news/ooredoo-establishes-qatars-first-quantum-safe-communications-link

On June 2, High Q Technologies and Creative Biostructure established a partnership to support the broader adoption of electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy in pharmaceutical and biotechnology research. The collaboration combines High Q Technologies' FATHOM quantum EPR spectroscopy platform with Creative Biostructure's expertise in experimental design, scientific consulting, and workflow support. The companies aim to help researchers study protein dynamics, molecular motion, and complex biological systems involved in drug discovery.

**Source:** https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260602896746/en/High-Q-Technologies-and-Creative-Biostructure-Announce-Strategic-Partnership-Expanding-Global-Access-to-Quantum-Enabled-EPR-Spectroscopy

This development reflects strong capital market confidence in cutting-edge quantum computing technology and IQM's industry-leading position, and will accelerate the commercialization and technological iteration of quantum technology.

On June 2, VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland (VTT) launched the QScale project in collaboration with Tampere University and Aalto University, with funding from Business Finland. On June 2, Quantinuum and Mitsubishi Electric signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to establish a strategic partnership. Leveraging Quantinuum's high-fidelity ion trap quantum systems and algorithmic services, combined with Mitsubishi Electric's expertise in manufacturing and digitalization, the two parties will focus on areas such as computer-aided engineering (CAE) to jointly develop next-generation quantum and hybrid methods for advanced industrial engineering and design, with the goal of proactively shaping future commercial application scenarios.

## QuiX Quantum Announces Installation of Real-Time Control Component for Universal Photonic Quantum Computer

On June 2, hardware developer QuiX Quantum announced the initial installation of its feed-forward control unit (FFCU), a high-performance hardware component developed for the company's universal photonic quantum computing architecture. The high-performance module is directly integrated into the company's universal photonic quantum computing stack and is designed to handle real-time adaptive operations. By automating state reconstruction at the hardware level, the control mechanism establishes the fast-feedback loops required for measurement-based quantum computing architectures.

**Source:** https://www.einpresswire.com/article/916649241/quix-quantum-installs-real-time-control-component-for-universal-photonic-quantum-computer

## Atom Computing Announces Industry-First Complete Demonstration of Toric Code Quantum Error Correction

On June 3, U.S. quantum computing company Atom Computing announced the successful completion of the industry's first full demonstration of quantum error correction (QEC) using a toric code. Testing showed that error rates in the company's neutral atom system decrease as the number of qubits used in computation increases. This achievement makes Atom Computing one of only two companies worldwide capable of performing multiple rounds of sustained quantum error correction, and the first to do so in the neutral atom technology domain, marking a key step toward fault-tolerant quantum computing.

**Source:** https://atom-computing.com/atom-computing-reveals-quantum-error-correction-with-toric-code/

On June 3, Infineon integrated its OPTIGA TPM SLB 9672 security chip with NVIDIA's Jetson Thor platform to provide hardware-based, quantum-resilient root of trust for robotics and physical AI systems. The TPM supports secure key storage, measured boot, remote attestation, encrypted communications, and protected software updates over the lifecycle of autonomous systems. Infineon stated that its TPM roadmap includes support for NIST-standardized post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithms, helping future robotic deployments address evolving security and compliance requirements.

## Guangxi Normal University et al. Investigate Geometry-Optimized Error-Resistant Quantum Computing with Rydberg Atoms

This study proposes a geometrically optimized universal non-adiabatic holonomic quantum computation (NHQC) framework that suppresses Rabi frequency errors by controlling geometric phases, breaking the intrinsic trade-off between robustness and evolution time. Numerical simulations show that under decoherence combined with up to 20% Rabi frequency detuning, single-qubit gate fidelity exceeds 99.999% and two-qubit entangling gate fidelity exceeds 99.94%. This work provides an efficient approach to high-fidelity, error-resistant quantum computing on neutral atom platforms, contributing to scalable quantum information processing.

The research results were published on June 1 in *Physical Review Applied*.

**Source:** https://journals.aps.org/prapplied/abstract/10.1103/6x8r-5gj1

## UC Berkeley et al. Describe Error-Field Duality for Mixed-State Topological Order and Decoherence-Induced Phase Transitions

This study constructs an effective field theory to describe the effect of decoherence on Abelian topological order systems and their quantum information protection capacity. Within the dual topological field theory framework, decoherence is mapped to temporal defects, which can induce boundary phase transitions accompanied by anyon condensation at the critical coupling. Leveraging the Lagrangian subgroup of the dual topological order, the study realizes a classification of decoherence-induced phases and information loss. This work extends the theory of error-correction phase transitions in stabilizer codes to general topological systems, confirming that error-correction phase transitions originate from topological phase transitions in the intrinsic topological order of mixed states, and provides a new theoretical framework for research on topological quantum fault-tolerance mechanisms.

The research results were published on June 1 in *Physical Review Letters*.

**Source:** https://journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/6f98-tvb8

## Korea Institute for Advanced Study et al. Propose Constant Geometric Rate Scheduling for Adiabatic State Preparation

This study proposes a constant geometric rate (CGS) scheduling scheme that traverses adiabatic paths at a uniform geometric rate, reducing the evolution scaling to Δ⁻¹ when path length is independent of the energy gap. The study further designs a piecewise CGS scheme that requires only a global lower bound on the energy gap to partition paths online, reducing the need for prior spectral information. Numerical tests on unstructured search, the nitrogen molecule, and iron–sulfur cluster systems confirm optimal scaling, achieving a quadratic speedup compared to conventional linear scheduling.

## University of Basel et al. Investigate Si/Si₁₋ₓGeₓ Vertical Double Quantum Dot Systems

This study explores Si/Si₁₋ₓGeₓ vertical double quantum dot systems, using device simulation to investigate micromagnet-free, all-electrically controlled Loss–DiVincenzo spin qubits. Spin–orbit coupling within the quantum dot and gate-induced strain produce spatially varying g-factors and valley splittings on the order of 250 μeV, giving rise to multiple pathways for ultrafast, all-electrical single-qubit control: alternating-electric-field electric dipole spin resonance, gate-voltage-tunable spin resonance, and sub-nanosecond qubit gates via inter-dot tunneling. This architecture completely eliminates the need for micromagnets, simplifies semiconductor fabrication, and strongly promotes scalable integration of silicon spin qubits.

The research results were published on June 1 in *Physical Review Research*.

This study proposes a novel, ancilla-free circuit transformation rule termed "multi-product commutation relations (MCR)." The research team rewrites any given quantum circuit into a structure comprising a Clifford block followed by sequential Pauli computation. By exploiting special commutativity properties among multiple Pauli operators, MCR enables the commutation of seemingly non-commuting gate operations, thereby achieving gate reordering that conventional pairwise-commutation approaches cannot accomplish.

## Bar-Ilan University et al. Analyze Quantum Majority Voting Rules Under Noisy Conditions

This study presents the first systematic evaluation of the impact of realistic noise on the performance and social ranking distributions of the "quantum majority rule (QMR)" by running quantum circuits on both ideal simulators and real noisy IBM Quantum hardware (NISQ devices). The study shows that the rule retains a degree of robustness under moderate noise, but that strong noise or particular voter configurations can cause voting outcomes to shift. ## University of Tokyo et al. Improve Variational Counterdiabatic Driving via Weighted Action and Computer Algebra

Variational counterdiabatic driving is the dominant control approach for achieving high-fidelity adiabatic evolution in short times; its core adiabatic gauge potential (AGP) exhibits algebraic non-uniqueness. This study introduces new degrees of freedom to construct a weighted variational optimization scheme that improves the driving design, incorporating non-local information into local driving coefficients through customized matrix weights. Combined with computer algebra, an efficient solving algorithm is developed, and the framework can serve as a universal replacement for conventional variational counterdiabatic approaches. Numerical simulations on the quantum Ising model demonstrate that the weighted optimization scheme achieves higher evolution fidelity than conventional methods for ground-state adiabatic evolution.

The research results were published on June 2 in *PRX Quantum*.

## RIKEN et al. Propose Single-Shot Cross-Spectral Analysis for Extracting Noise Cross-Correlations

This study proposes a single-shot cross-spectral (SSCS) analysis method that directly extracts the autocorrelation and cross-power spectral density of dephasing noise across two qubits from single-shot Ramsey readout data on individual qubits, without repeated sampling to reconstruct energy-level fluctuations, and with robustness against state preparation and measurement (SPAM) errors. This study proposes a moment-matching universal dilation framework that, relying on algebraic constraints of ancilla qubits, enables simulation of arbitrary non-Hermitian linear dynamics on unitary quantum hardware, unifying existing dilation theories and broadening the hardware-compatible algorithm design space. ## University of Bremen Investigates Frequency Shifts Induced by Relativistic and Retardation Effects in Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution

Key capacity simulations across multiple satellite orbit and ground-station configurations show that frequency shift corrections arising from relativistic and retardation effects significantly impact communication performance and must be compensated in the engineering design of satellite-to-ground continuous-variable quantum key distribution (CV-QKD) systems.

## UC Berkeley et al. Investigate the Breakdown of Disorder-Suppressed Floquet Thermalization Under Bichromatic Driving
